notes.title: Gamescom demo available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41556333/bbb8c50969b56a62cd2325aad28947a6e90bb141.jpg[/img]🎉 Exciting news for all pixel cat heroes! 🎉

We're thrilled to announce that the 99 Pixel Cats demo that will be showcased at Gamescom is now available! 🐾 Here's what's new:

🚀 Many Bug Fixes: We’ve squashed those pesky bugs to ensure a smoother, more delightful gameplay experience.

🌍 Brand New Level: Get ready to explore a new level full of surprises! 

🎮 Gameplay Improvements: We've fine-tuned the mechanics to make your cat-tastic adventure even more enjoyable!

Don't miss out—experience the latest demo and get a sneak peek of what's coming at Gamescom! 😺
